top_signals.title: How India Can Turn Its Culture into Economic Power | Emerging
top_signals.summary: India produces more films than any other country and turned cricket into a multi-billion dollar sport. And yet it hasn’t built a strong global audience. In this episode of Emerging, Haslinda Amin sits down with JioStar’s Uday Shankar to discuss whether India can replicate the soft power success of places like China and South Korea. (Source: Bloomberg)
